question: Should this terminal-detection update receive a short real-TTY smoke check before merge, rather than relying only on the completed CI matrix?
rationale: The branch is otherwise narrow and correct, but its only upstream behavior change affects interactive-terminal detection, which the supplied CI results do not directly demonstrate.

options.title: Capture a real-terminal smoke check
options.body: Run Gitcrawl in an interactive terminal on one supported platform and attach a redacted terminal transcript or recording before merge.

options.title: Accept the CI-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the clean dependency-only diff and completed platform CI while accepting the residual terminal-emulation uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Capture a real-terminal smoke check
recommendation.body: Run Gitcrawl in an interactive terminal on one supported platform and attach a redacted terminal transcript or recording before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only non-bot contributor connected to recent merged Gitcrawl history in the supplied evidence; feature ownership could not be established more precisely.
